approval_ref: The active goal requires continued RFI/Submittal/Email adaptability and accuracy; CR-0075 must not hide explicit Email attachment provenance when a reviewer corrects workflow classification.
notes: Reproduce the interaction through the public workflow-index function before changing code.
An explicit selected-attachment relationship must depend on immutable parsed Email metadata, not the editable effective document type.
Keep the correction overlay, source evidence, attachment import ledger and parser summary unchanged; add no dependency or model call.
Completed offline with 660 Python tests, 24 UI tests and 11 deployment tests. Full checks, specification sync, dependency validation, change-scope validation and the 379-file source manifest passed.
title: Preserve email attachment provenance after workflow correction
objective: Keep an explicitly imported Email attachment relationship visible after the parent Email receives a run-scoped RFI, Submittal or Other classification correction, without weakening the non-Email-parent guard.
